Description: Verify an unmatched route GET /nope answers 404 with the fixed constant body {'detail': 'Not Found'} instead of the framework default body
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}

Description: Verify a method with no route on an existing path DELETE /passes/1 stays 404 with {'detail': 'Not Found'} and no 405 Method Not Allowed is introduced
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}

Description: Verify the not-found body never reflects caller-controlled path text: GET /nope/<script>alert(1)</script> answers 404 with only {'detail': 'Not Found'}
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'} and the response body contains no text from the request path (no 'script', no 'alert')

Description: Verify the 404 body carries no framework keys: GET /nope answers a body with no 'message', 'error' or 'statusCode' key
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'} and the body has no key named 'message', 'error' or 'statusCode'

Description: Verify the 404 response Content-Type is application/json for an unmatched route GET /nope
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. Response header Content-Type is application/json. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}

Description: Verify a route-owned 404 is unchanged: GET /passes/999999999 still answers {'detail': 'pass not found'} and is not intercepted by the not-found handler
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'pass not found'}

Description: Verify the delivered /health route still answers 200 {'status': 'ok'} — the not-found handler does not intercept registered routes
Verify the single app-instance not-found handler registered in buildApp takes effect for an unmatched route GET /nope (not the framework default serializer)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'} and the body has no key named 'message', 'error' or 'statusCode'

Description: Verify the app-instance not-found handler covers every route module: an unmatched path under the passes prefix GET /passes/abc/extra answers 404 {'detail': 'Not Found'}
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}

Description: Verify an unmatched method+path POST /nope with a JSON body answers 404 with {'detail': 'Not Found'} and Content-Type application/json
Steps: Call POST /nope with header Content-Type: application/json and JSON {}
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. Response header Content-Type is application/json. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}

Description: Verify a parser-level rejection is answered with the fixed constant body: GET /nope carrying a non-numeric Content-Length header 'xyz' answers 400 {'detail': 'Bad Request'} with no framework keys (E2, B9, B10, B11, B12)
Steps: Call GET /nope with header Content-Length: xyz
ExpectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request. Response header Content-Type is application/json. JSON contains {'detail': 'Bad Request'} and the body has no key named 'message', 'error' or 'statusCode'

Description: Verify the parser-level 400 applies app-wide to a MATCHED route too: GET /health carrying a negative Content-Length header '-1' answers 400 {'detail': 'Bad Request'} because the parser runs before routing (E2, B11)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 400 Bad Request. JSON contains {'detail': 'Bad Request'} and the body has no key named 'message', 'error' or 'statusCode'

Description: Verify a well-formed Content-Length leaves the not-found path unaffected: GET /nope with Content-Length: 0 still answers 404 {'detail': 'Not Found'} (B13)
ExpectedResult: HTTP 404 Not Found. JSON contains {'detail': 'Not Found'}
